svg.title: Check the scope of a browser helper
svg.desc: The active tab and the permissions you grant determine what a helper can use for a task. Identify. Open the practice page and read its address. Inspect. Check the page or site access the helper requests. Verify. Compare its answer or action with what you can see on the intended page.
